notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Nurturing Presence attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Barrenton Medic token enters the battlefield, the nontoken Barrenton Medic triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
